xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana:
1. Transactions between JM Financial Limited and its Wholly Owned Subsidiaries are not included.
2. The disclosures include Related Party Transactions entered into by subsidiaries viz., JM Financial Products Limited and JM Financial Credit Solutions Limited, which ceased to be high value debt listed entities during this half year. The disclosures also include transactions entered into by their respective step-down subsidiaries, viz., JM Financial Home Loans Limited and JM Financial Asset Reconstruction Company Limited.
3. The amount stated in the column “Value of transaction” for the reporting period represents the aggregate of all the transactions entered into during the reporting period. The maximum value of transactions at any point in time did not exceed the limit approved by the Audit Committee and/or shareholders, as applicable.
4. Related party transactions reported above are identified based on PAN of the related party available on record.
5. Non‐convertible debentures transactions include only primary issuances. Outstanding balances represent NCDs held by related parties as on reporting date. 6. Rs. 0.00 denotes amount below Rs. 50,000.
